**Back up first.** Before you install this version, make a backup in Settings › Backup & data.

**Support Forkcast on Ko-fi**
- The Ko-fi page is open: the card at the top of Settings and Support Forkcast in Settings › About now open it in your browser. Tips are voluntary and don't unlock anything.
- If you hide the card, it comes back after about 3 months or with the next major version, whichever comes first. If you hid it in 1.8.6, it shows once more.
